title: Canonical Zariski units restriction and pushforward cohomology comparison
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a morphism of schemes, and write $\mathcal O_X^\times$ and $\mathcal O_Z^\times$ for their abelian sheaves of units [def-sc-gm-torsor] on the small Zariski sites [def-sc-zariski-site]. Define $u_i:\mathcal O_X^\times\to i_*\mathcal O_Z^\times$ on each open $U\subseteq X$ by the units map of $i^\sharp(U):\mathcal O_X(U)\to\mathcal O_Z(i^{-1}U)$. For $p\in\mathbb N$, define $c_i^p:H^p(X,i_*\mathcal O_Z^\times)\to H^p(Z,\mathcal O_Z^\times)$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] by applying the exact abelian inverse-image functor $i^{-1}$ to an Ext class from the constant integer sheaf, identifying $i^{-1}\mathbb Z_X$ with $\mathbb Z_Z$, and then applying the counit $i^{-1}i_*\mathcal O_Z^\times\to\mathcal O_Z^\times$. Thus $c_i^p\circ H^p(u_i)$ is the canonical cohomology restriction on units.
